This is the KasirKu POS app (Next.js App Router + Supabase, at G:\PROJECT1\KasirKu). In an earlier session I built a "tiket" business type (venue ticketing: kolam renang/wisata) — numbered admission tickets per category (e.g. Pengunjung/Penunggu), weekday/holiday pricing, and a membership system. That work is already committed (commits 5719374 and f59331c). The user now wants 4 additional things added to that same feature, and I already asked clarifying questions and got clear answers. Do NOT write any code — produce a concrete, reviewable implementation plan only.

## Ground truth (verified by me already, treat as fact)

**Current checkout RPC** — `supabase/migrations/20260706200000_ticket_venue.sql` defines `checkout_ticket_transaction(p_business_id uuid, p_cashier_id uuid, p_items jsonb, p_payment_method text, p_received numeric default null, p_member_id uuid default null)`. `p_items` is currently `[{ticket_category_id, qty}]`. Inside, it loops items, locks the `ticket_categories` row `for update`, computes `v_unit_price` (member price if member selected, else weekday/holiday price computed from `extract(dow from current_date)` + a `ticket_holidays` table lookup), then loops `for i in 1..v_qty` inserting one `ticket_serials` row per unit with `serial_no := v_category.next_serial` (incrementing a persistent counter column on `ticket_categories`, continuous, never reset, race-safe via the row lock). Same migration also has `void_ticket_transaction(p_business_id, p_transaction_id, p_manager_pin, p_reason)` — manager-PIN verified via `extensions.crypt`, just flips `voided`/`voided_at`/`void_reason`/`voided_by`, does not touch serials.

**Tables**: `ticket_categories` (id, business_id, name, price_weekday, price_holiday, member_price, next_serial int, active, deleted_at), `ticket_holidays` (business_id, holiday_date, label), `members` (id, business_id, member_code text unique-per-business-when-not-deleted, name, phone, valid_from date, valid_until date, note, deleted_at), `ticket_transactions` (header: business_id, shift_id, cashier_id, member_id, invoice_number, date, is_holiday, subtotal, service, tax, total, payment_method, received, change, voided/voided_at/void_reason/voided_by), `ticket_serials` (one row per physical ticket: ticket_transaction_id, ticket_category_id, business_id, serial_no int, price, is_member_price — unique on (business_id, ticket_category_id, serial_no)).

**Client wrapper** `src/app/business/[businessId]/pos/ticket-actions.ts`: `checkoutTicket(businessId, cashierId, items: {ticketCategoryId, qty}[], paymentMethod, received, memberId)` calls the RPC mapping `items` to `{ticket_category_id, qty}`. Also has `lookupMemberByCode(businessId, code)` (exact-match query on `members.member_code`, validates today is within `valid_from`/`valid_until`) and `voidTicketTransaction(businessId, transactionId, managerPin, reason)`.

**POS screen** `src/app/business/[businessId]/pos/ticket-pos-screen.tsx`: client component. Cart state is `qtyByCategory: Record<categoryId, number>`, with a `changeQty(categoryId, delta)` functional-update helper (I already fixed a stale-closure bug here — must keep using the functional-update pattern for any new cart state). Each category renders as a card with a `−`/count/`+` stepper. There's a "Member (opsional)" box: a text input for member code + "Cari" button calling `lookupMemberByCode`, showing the found member with a "Lepas" (release) button. Below that, category cards, then a cart/payment sidebar (payment method buttons, received amount, confirm). `isHoliday` and `categories` (with priceWeekday/priceHoliday/memberPrice) are passed in as props from the server page.

**Server page** `src/app/business/[businessId]/pos/page.tsx`: for `business.business_type === "tiket"`, fetches `ticket_categories` (active, not deleted) and `custom_payment_methods`, computes `isHoliday` server-side (weekday check + `ticket_holidays` lookup for today), renders `<TicketPosScreen>`. Does NOT currently fetch the members list.

**Members back-office CRUD** already exists at `src/app/business/[businessId]/(dashboard)/members/`: `page.tsx` (list), `actions.ts` (`addMember(businessId, prevState, formData)`, `editMember`, `deleteMember` — all plain exported server actions, reusable from anywhere, not route-bound), `add-member-form.tsx` (client form component using `useActionState`), `[memberId]/page.tsx` (detail), `[memberId]/edit-member-form.tsx`, `[memberId]/delete-member-button.tsx`.

**Ticket reports** `src/app/business/[businessId]/(dashboard)/ticket-reports/page.tsx`: server component, lists one row per `ticket_serials` joined to its `ticket_transactions` (invoice, date, category, serial_no, price, member flag, voided), with period/category/serial-range filters (reusing `../reports/period.ts`'s `parsePeriod`/`getPeriodRange`/`PERIOD_LABELS`/`PERIOD_DESCRIPTIONS`), plus a KPI section (active member count, tickets sold, revenue) and a per-category summary. Rows are `<Link>`s to `ticket-reports/[transactionId]/page.tsx` (detail page — shows full breakdown, cashier, member, day-type, void form) which links to `ticket-reports/[transactionId]/receipt/page.tsx` (printable receipt, monospace, `window.print()`).

**Existing CSV export pattern to mirror**: `src/app/business/[businessId]/(dashboard)/reports/export/route.ts` — a `GET` route handler reading `?type=menu|transactions&period=...&from=...&to=...`, builds `(string|number)[][]` rows, joins with a `csvEscape`/`toCsv` helper, returns `Response` with `Content-Type: text/csv; charset=utf-8` and a `﻿` BOM prefix (so Excel opens it as UTF-8) plus `Content-Disposition: attachment; filename=...`. `reports/page.tsx` links to it via two buttons (`?type=menu`, `?type=transactions`).

**No barcode library exists yet** in `node_modules` or `package.json` — this is a fresh addition. Also no existing barcode-scanning UI anywhere in the app (a `products.barcode` column exists but is unused by any UI).

**Cashier auth model** (important, already verified): `src/lib/cashier-session.ts` — the cashier PIN cookie is explicitly documented as "not a security boundary... the real access-control boundary is the owner's Supabase Auth session (checked by RLS on every query)". This means the browser/device using the POS screen already carries the owner's Supabase Auth cookie (that's how the RLS-protected queries in `pos/page.tsx` succeed at all) — the PIN is just a "who's holding the device" UI-level marker. Practical implication: there is no additional auth work needed to let "the cashier" add/view members from the POS screen — it only requires building the UI inside the POS flow so staff don't have to leave the kasir screen to reach the owner-oriented `(dashboard)/members` pages.

## The 4 things the user asked for (I already clarified each with them)

1. **Excel/CSV export for ticket reports** — need exports for: every transaction (like the existing `PenjTransaksi.csv` but for `ticket_transactions`), per-ticket breakdown (one row per `ticket_serials`, like `PenjMenu.csv`'s spirit but per physical ticket), and an hourly breakdown (revenue/count aggregated by hour of day) — user said "setiap transaksi baik jam, transaksi per tiket dan laporan lain nya" (every transaction whether by hour, transaction-per-ticket, and other reports). Three CSV exports is the agreed scope.

2. **Cashier can add and view members directly from the POS screen** — confirmed: "Langsung dari layar kasir (POS)" — i.e. build this into `ticket-pos-screen.tsx` itself (a browsable/searchable member list + an inline "add new member" mini-form), not just relying on the existing back-office `/members` pages.

3. **Barcode**: confirmed BOTH — (a) scanning a member's card at checkout should work by just scanning (no manual typing/clicking "Cari") — i.e. the existing member-code lookup input needs auto-focus + auto-submit-on-Enter (USB barcode scanners act as a keyboard, typing the code then sending Enter), AND (b) the system needs to actually generate/print a barcode for each member (e.g. Code128 encoding the existing `member_code` text) so the venue can produce physical member cards — user confirmed "Sistem juga perlu generate & cetak barcode kartu member" (the system also needs to generate & print the member card barcode).

4. **Manual physical ticket number per unit** — confirmed: "Nomor tiket fisik per orang diketik manual" — every individual ticket sold (each Pengunjung/Penunggu unit, not just qty) must have a manually-typed physical ticket number recorded (from a paper ticket booklet), IN ADDITION TO the existing system auto-serial (`ticket_serials.next_serial`/`serial_no`, which must keep working exactly as-is — continuous, never resets, race-safe). This is a real schema change: `ticket_serials` needs a new required text field for the physical number, and the checkout flow's cart UI must change from a simple qty stepper to a per-unit list where each unit gets its own physical-number text input.

## What I need from your plan

Produce a concrete, file-by-file implementation plan (no code needed for every file, but DO write full SQL for any migration since schema changes are the highest-risk, hardest-to-fix-after-the-fact part) covering:

1. **Migration** for item 4: add a `manual_number` column to `ticket_serials` (decide nullable-then-backfill-then-not-null vs. other approaches, given there are already 4 existing test rows in the live dev database from my earlier testing that need a safe backfill — e.g. defaulting existing rows' `manual_number` to their `serial_no` cast to text), a uniqueness constraint scoped sensibly (I'd guess `(business_id, ticket_category_id, manual_number)`, mirroring how `serial_no` is scoped — flag if you disagree), and an updated `checkout_ticket_transaction` function body (`create or replace`, same SQL parameter types so no signature/overload drop needed — only the *shape* of the JSON inside `p_items` changes) that accepts `p_items` as `[{ticket_category_id, manual_numbers: string[]}]` instead of `{ticket_category_id, qty}`, deriving qty from array length, looping `jsonb_array_elements_text` to insert one `ticket_serials` row per manual number (validating each is non-blank, raising a clear exception otherwise), while preserving the exact existing pricing/holiday/member/tax/service logic unchanged.

2. **`ticket-actions.ts` changes**: update `checkoutTicket`'s `items` param shape and the RPC call mapping; handle a friendly error message when the new unique constraint fires (Postgres code `23505`) similar to how `settings/actions.ts`'s `addTicketCategory` catches `error.code === "23505"`.

3. **`ticket-pos-screen.tsx` cart UI rework**: replacing the qty stepper with a per-unit list (one text input per physical ticket number, with an add/remove-row affordance per category) — describe the state shape change and the key interaction points that must preserve the existing functional-update-state fix (no stale closures), without breaking the existing member-pricing/day-type-pricing math (`unitPriceFor`), payment flow, or the "Belum ada tiket dipilih"/cart-summary rendering.

4. **Member browsing + inline add, embedded in the POS screen**: what to fetch server-side in `pos/page.tsx` (full members list, mirroring how the F&B/Retail `pos-screen.tsx` fetches a full `customers` list for its picker — reference that existing picker's UI pattern), and a plan for a new small component (e.g. `member-panel.tsx`) that: (a) keeps the existing exact-code lookup input (now with auto-focus + auto-submit-on-Enter for barcode scanners), (b) adds a browsable/searchable list of all members to click-select, (c) adds an inline "add new member" mini-form reusing the existing `addMember` server action from `(dashboard)/members/actions.ts` directly (no duplication) followed by `router.refresh()`.

5. **Barcode generation for a printable member card**: recommend adding the `jsbarcode` npm package (small, dependency-free, standard choice — flag if you know a reason not to), a new client component rendering an SVG barcode from `member_code` via a `useEffect` + ref, and a new print-friendly route (mirroring the existing `ticket-reports/[transactionId]/receipt/page.tsx` + `print-button.tsx` pattern) hosted under the member detail page, e.g. `members/[memberId]/card/page.tsx` + `members/[memberId]/card/print-button.tsx`, linked from `members/[memberId]/page.tsx`.

6. **CSV export route** `ticket-reports/export/route.ts` mirroring the existing `reports/export/route.ts` pattern exactly (BOM, `csvEscape`/`toCsv`, `Content-Disposition`), supporting `type=transactions|tickets|hourly`, reusing `../../reports/period.ts` helpers for date-range parsing, and wiring 3 export buttons into `ticket-reports/page.tsx`. Also note where `manual_number` should be additively surfaced for reconciliation clarity: the `ticket-reports/page.tsx` row list, the `[transactionId]/page.tsx` detail page, and the `[transactionId]/receipt/page.tsx` receipt — all three currently show `serial_no` and should now also show `manual_number` alongside it.

7. **Order of implementation** (schema/RPC first since it's highest-risk and blocks everything else, then cart UI, then member panel, then barcode/card, then CSV export) and a **verification plan**: what to check via the Supabase SQL editor after the migration is pasted (this project's migrations are applied manually — no linked CLI), and what to click through in the browser preview for each piece (there's an existing throwaway test business "Kolam Renang Test" — id `f43c8529-7fe5-4074-9e98-43335da31267` — with a test cashier "Kasir Tiket" PIN `1234`/manajer, categories "Pengunjung"/"Penunggu", and a member "Budi Member" code `M-0001`, that can be reused for testing rather than creating fresh fixtures).

Keep the plan concrete and scannable — exact file paths, not vague descriptions. Flag any place where you think my ground-truth summary above might be wrong or where you'd choose a different approach, so I can address it before finalizing.

142	-- kontinu & tidak reset. voided ada di header (ticket_transactions), serial

146	create table public.ticket_serials (
147	  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
148	  ticket_transaction_id uuid not null references public.ticket_transactions (id) on delete cascade,
149	  ticket_category_id uuid not null references public.ticket_categories (id),
150	  business_id uuid not null references public.businesses (id) on delete cascade,
151	  serial_no int not null,
152	  price numeric(12, 2) not null,
153	  is_member_price boolean not null default false,
154	  constraint ticket_serials_business_id_category_id_serial_no_key
155	    unique (business_id, ticket_category_id, serial_no)
156	);

170	-- checkout_ticket_transaction RPC -----------------------------------------
171	-- p_items: array of {ticket_category_id, qty}. Hari libur dihitung DI DALAM
172	-- RPC (bukan dipercaya dari client) supaya tidak bisa dipalsukan dan tetap
173	-- benar walau tanggal lokal di browser meleset.
174	
175	create or replace function public.checkout_ticket_transaction(
176	  p_business_id uuid,
177	  p_cashier_id uuid,
178	  p_items jsonb, -- array of {ticket_category_id, qty}
179	  p_payment_method text,
180	  p_received numeric default null,
181	  p_member_id uuid default null
182	)
183	returns table (transaction_id uuid, invoice_number text)
184	language plpgsql
185	security definer
186	set search_path = ''
187	as $$
188	declare
189	  v_business record;
190	  v_member record;
191	  v_invoice_number text;
192	  v_seq int;
193	  v_is_holiday boolean;
194	  v_subtotal numeric(12, 2) := 0;
195	  v_service numeric(12, 2) := 0;
196	  v_tax numeric(12, 2) := 0;
197	  v_total numeric(12, 2);
198	  v_change numeric(12, 2);
199	  v_transaction_id uuid;
200	  v_shift_id uuid;
201	  v_item jsonb;
202	  v_category_id uuid;
203	  v_category record;
204	  v_qty int;
205	  v_use_member_price boolean := false;
206	  v_unit_price numeric(12, 2);
207	  v_serial int;
208	  i int;
209	begin
210	  if not private.owns_business(p_business_id) then
211	    raise exception 'not authorized';
212	  end if;
213	
214	  if not exists (
215	    select 1 from public.cashiers c
216	    where c.id = p_cashier_id and c.business_id = p_business_id and c.active
217	  ) then
218	    raise exception 'invalid cashier';
219	  end if;
220	
221	  if p_payment_method is null or length(trim(p_payment_method)) = 0 then
222	    raise exception 'payment method required';
223	  end if;
224	
225	  if p_items is null or jsonb_array_length(p_items) = 0 then
226	    raise exception 'cart is empty';
227	  end if;
228	
229	  select b.tax_enabled, b.tax_rate, b.service_enabled, b.service_rate
230	  into v_business
231	  from public.businesses b
232	  where b.id = p_business_id;
233	
234	  select id into v_shift_id
235	  from public.shifts
236	  where business_id = p_business_id and closed_at is null
237	  limit 1;
238	
239	  if v_shift_id is null then
240	    raise exception 'no active shift — open a shift before selling';
241	  end if;
242	
243	  if p_member_id is not null then
244	    select m.id, m.valid_from, m.valid_until
245	    into v_member
246	    from public.members m
247	    where m.id = p_member_id
248	      and m.business_id = p_business_id
249	      and m.deleted_at is null;
250	
251	    if not found then
252	      raise exception 'member not found';
253	    end if;
254	
255	    if current_date < v_member.valid_from or current_date > v_member.valid_until then
256	      raise exception 'membership tidak aktif (kadaluarsa atau belum berlaku)';
257	    end if;
258	
259	    v_use_member_price := true;
260	  end if;
261	
262	  v_is_holiday := extract(dow from current_date) in (0, 6)
263	    or exists (
264	      select 1 from public.ticket_holidays h
265	      where h.business_id = p_business_id and h.holiday_date = current_date
266	    );
267	
268	  select count(*) + 1 into v_seq
269	  from public.ticket_transactions t
270	  where t.business_id = p_business_id
271	    and t.date::date = current_date;
272	
273	  v_invoice_number := 'TIX-' || to_char(current_date, 'YYYYMMDD') || '-' || lpad(v_seq::text, 4, '0');
274	
275	  insert into public.ticket_transactions (
276	    business_id, shift_id, cashier_id, member_id, invoice_number, date,
277	    is_holiday, subtotal, service, tax, total, payment_method, received, change
278	  ) values (
279	    p_business_id, v_shift_id, p_cashier_id, p_member_id, v_invoice_number, now(),
280	    v_is_holiday, 0, 0, 0, 0, p_payment_method, p_received, 0
281	  )
282	  returning id into v_transaction_id;
283	
284	  for v_item in select * from jsonb_array_elements(p_items)
285	  loop
286	    v_category_id := (v_item ->> 'ticket_category_id')::uuid;
287	    v_qty := (v_item ->> 'qty')::int;
288	
289	    if v_qty is null or v_qty <= 0 then
290	      raise exception 'invalid quantity';
291	    end if;
292	
293	    select * into v_category
294	    from public.ticket_categories
295	    where id = v_category_id
296	      and business_id = p_business_id
297	      and deleted_at is null
298	    for update;
299	
300	    if not found then
301	      raise exception 'ticket category not found: %', v_category_id;
302	    end if;
303	
304	    v_unit_price := case
305	      when v_use_member_price then v_category.member_price
306	      when v_is_holiday then v_category.price_holiday
307	      else v_category.price_weekday
308	    end;
309	
310	    for i in 1..v_qty loop
311	      v_serial := v_category.next_serial;
312	
313	      insert into public.ticket_serials (
314	        ticket_transaction_id, ticket_category_id, business_id,
315	        serial_no, price, is_member_price
316	      ) values (
317	        v_transaction_id, v_category_id, p_business_id,
318	        v_serial, v_unit_price, v_use_member_price
319	      );
320	
321	      v_category.next_serial := v_category.next_serial + 1;
322	      v_subtotal := v_subtotal + v_unit_price;
323	    end loop;
324	
325	    update public.ticket_categories
326	    set next_serial = v_category.next_serial
327	    where id = v_category_id;
328	  end loop;
329	
330	  if v_business.service_enabled then
331	    v_service := round(v_subtotal * v_business.service_rate / 100);
332	  end if;
333	
334	  if v_business.tax_enabled then
335	    v_tax := round((v_subtotal + v_service) * v_business.tax_rate / 100);
336	  end if;
337	
338	  v_total := v_subtotal + v_service + v_tax;
339	  v_change := greatest(coalesce(p_received, v_total) - v_total, 0);
340	
341	  update public.ticket_transactions
342	  set subtotal = v_subtotal,
343	      service = v_service,
344	      tax = v_tax,
345	      total = v_total,
346	      change = v_change
347	  where id = v_transaction_id;
348	
349	  return query select v_transaction_id, v_invoice_number;
350	end;
351	$$;
352	
353	grant execute on function public.checkout_ticket_transaction(uuid, uuid, jsonb, text, numeric, uuid) to authenticated;

355	-- void_ticket_transaction RPC ----------------------------------------------
356	-- Pola sama persis dengan void_transaction (verifikasi PIN manajer via
357	-- crypt). Tidak ada stok yang dikembalikan — serial tetap dialokasikan
358	-- permanen (tiket fisik sudah terlanjur dicetak/diberikan).
359	
360	create or replace function public.void_ticket_transaction(
361	  p_business_id uuid,
362	  p_transaction_id uuid,
363	  p_manager_pin text,
364	  p_reason text default null
365	)
366	returns table (voided_by_name text)
367	language plpgsql
368	security definer
369	set search_path = ''
370	as $$
371	declare
372	  v_manager record;
373	  v_tx record;
374	begin
375	  if not private.owns_business(p_business_id) then
376	    raise exception 'not authorized';
377	  end if;
378	
379	  select c.id, c.name
380	  into v_manager
381	  from public.cashiers c
382	  where c.business_id = p_business_id
383	    and c.role = 'manajer'
384	    and c.active
385	    and c.pin_hash = extensions.crypt(p_manager_pin, c.pin_hash)
386	  limit 1;
387	
388	  if not found then
389	    raise exception 'PIN salah atau tidak memiliki otorisasi';
390	  end if;
391	
392	  select t.id, t.voided
393	  into v_tx
394	  from public.ticket_transactions t
395	  where t.id = p_transaction_id
396	    and t.business_id = p_business_id
397	  for update;
398	
399	  if not found then
400	    raise exception 'transaction not found';
401	  end if;
402	
403	  if v_tx.voided then
404	    raise exception 'transaksi sudah dibatalkan';
405	  end if;
406	
407	  update public.ticket_transactions
408	  set voided = true,
409	      voided_at = now(),
410	      void_reason = nullif(left(trim(p_reason), 200), ''),
411	      voided_by = v_manager.id
412	  where id = p_transaction_id;
413	
414	  return query select v_manager.name;
415	end;
416	$$;
417	
418	grant execute on function public.void_ticket_transaction(uuid, uuid, text, text) to authenticated;
